# Quartly

> Making Tax Digital for Income Tax is live since 6 April 2026. If your qualifying income is over £50,000 you must send HMRC quarterly updates (5 August, 5 November, 5 February, 5 May). Quartly checks if you're in scope and stamps your four deadlines + final declaration. Everything runs in the browser.

- **Market:** United Kingdom · sole traders, freelancers and landlords
- **Source of live data:** HMRC guidance (gov.uk) verified 12/08/2026
- **Design system:** Cálido-redondeado (Baloo 2 + Inter, self-hosted) · modular 2x2 quarter logo · warm paper + ink navy + FreeAgent orange

## What it solves
MTD for Income Tax replaces paper self-assessment for in-scope sole traders and landlords: digital records + 4 quarterly updates per year + a final declaration. Thresholds: £50,000 from 6 April 2026, £30,000 from 6 April 2027, £20,000 from 6 April 2028. Penalties are points-based (1 point per missed update, £200 at 4 points), with a 2026-27 tolerance for late quarterly updates — but not for late final declarations.

## Comparison
- Quartly · Free + Pro $6 · 1 minute · In your browser
- GOV.UK step-by-step · Free · 30-60 min · Reading
- Accountant / MTD software (FreeAgent, Xero) · Subscription · Setup · Ongoing filing
